# EmptyState

What a view shows when it has nothing to show yet: a picture, a short header, one line saying what goes here, and the action that fills it. It invites; it does not apologize. It also fills the slot when content cannot be shown: a load failure ("Couldn't load sessions" with Try again) or no access (the plain reason and who can help). Those are the same parts with different words, so they need no props of their own. - **image** is a slot for an Illustration or any picture. Without it, `icon` (a Font Awesome Free solid name) stands in. Both are decorative. - **header** is a heading one level below the section that holds the EmptyState, so it joins the page's outline. - **primaryAction** is one filled Button; **secondaryAction** an optional outlined one after it. - **spacing** `default` centers in a view on Heading/medium 20; `compact` fits a table body or a card on Heading/small 16 with a smaller picture. Pass it to a Table's `emptyState` slot.

Also asked as: no data, zero state, blank slate.

**Import:** `import { EmptyState } from '@/components';`

## Usage

Use `EmptyState` when a view, panel, card or table has no content yet, in place
of a blank area or a bare "No results". It carries a picture, a header, one line
and one primary action.

Use `EmptyState` too when content cannot be shown. A view, panel or table that
fails to load shows the failure in the same slot, with a filled **Try again**.
A view the person may not open says so plainly and names who can help. A
rejected form submit is not one of these: a danger `SectionMessage` at the top
of the form summarizes it. A failure in the background is a `Flag`.

### Kind guidance

| The view is | The slot says |
| --- | --- |
| Empty | What goes here and the action that fills it. Example: "No students yet", Add student. |
| Failed to load | What failed and a filled Try again. Example: "Couldn't load sessions". |
| No access | The plain reason and who can help, with no action. Example: "Only supervisors can see session notes. Ask your supervisor to add you." |

### Spacing guidance

| Spacing | When to use |
| --- | --- |
| Default | A whole view or panel. The header is Heading/medium 20. |
| Compact | A table body or a card. The header is Heading/small 16, with a smaller picture. |

## Best practices

### Use default spacing for a whole view. {#use-default-spacing-for-a-whole-view}

Compact spacing is for a table body or a card.

Do: Default spacing fills a view or panel.
Don't: Compact spacing leaves a full view cramped.

### Lead with one filled action. {#lead-with-one-filled-action}

The second action is outlined and never stands alone.

Do: A filled action leads.
Don't: An outlined action with nothing to lead.

### Invite with the next step. {#invite-with-the-next-step}

Say what goes here and what to do, in a warm voice. Never apologize.

Do: What goes here and what to do.
Don't: A cold label with no way forward.

### Show a load failure in the slot, with Try again. {#show-a-load-failure-in-the-slot-with-try-again}

State what failed and offer the retry. Never leave the view blank or send the
person to a message above it.

Do: What failed, with Try again.
Don't: An empty-view invitation when the load failed.

### Fill a Table with it, not around it. {#fill-a-table-with-it-not-around-it}

The Table keeps its header row and the EmptyState takes the body.

Do: An EmptyState in the Table's emptyState.
Don't: An EmptyState under a Table with an empty body.

## Accessibility

- **A real heading.** The header is one level below the section that holds the
  EmptyState, so it joins the page outline.
- **Decorative picture.** The image and icon are hidden from screen readers; the
  words carry the meaning.
- **Contrast.** Header and description use the text roles, which pass in every
  color mode.
- **Reflow.** The text wraps inside a column no wider than
  `--section-min-width-main`.

## Parts

1. **Picture.** An `image` slot or a Font Awesome Free `icon`. Decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
2. **Header.** A heading one level below the section that holds it.
3. **Description.** One line on what goes here and what to do.
4. **Actions.** One primary Button and an optional secondary one.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | Header, description and picture on their text and icon tokens. |
| Hovered | The message is not a control; its Buttons carry their own hovered state. |
| Pressed | The message is not a control; its Buttons carry their own pressed state. |
| Focused | Tab moves through the actions only. |
| Disabled | Not supported on the message; disable an action Button instead. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Header | `--heading-medium` (default), `--heading-small` (compact), `--ds-text` |
| Description | `--body-default`, `--ds-text-subtle` |
| Icon | `--ds-icon-subtle` |
| Spacing | `--stack-sm`, `--inline-md`, `--section-stack-sm`, `--section-stack-md`, `--page-stack-sm`, `--page-stack-md`, `--page-stack-lg` |
| Width | `--section-min-width-main` |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Keep the header short and specific to what is missing. | Apologize or blame: "Oops, nothing here." |
| Use the description for context that helps someone decide what to do. | Repeat the header in the description. |
| Make the primary action name the next step: "Add student". | Use a generic label such as "Continue". |
| Add a secondary action only for a real alternative, such as importing. | Add a second action just to fill space. |
| For a failure, say what happened in plain words and offer Try again. | Show an error code or "Something went wrong" with no next step. |
| For no access, give the reason and who can help. | Offer an action the person is not allowed to take. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `header` | node | — | What this view is, as a heading: "No students yet". |
| `description` | node | — | One line on what goes here and what to do, in an inviting voice. |
| `image` | node | — | Picture slot, such as an Illustration. Takes the place of `icon`. |
| `icon` | string | — | A Font Awesome Free solid name, such as "user-group", shown when there is no `image`. |
| `primaryAction` | node | — | The one action that fills the view: a filled Button. |
| `secondaryAction` | node | — | An optional second action: an outlined Button. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | `default` for a view or panel; `compact` for a table body or a card. |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
